newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY - Chicago exchanges' holiday hours.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY - Chicago exchanges' holiday hours.

text.p: Chicago's futures and options exchanges said some markets will be shut Monday, January 20, to observe Martin Luther King Jr Day.

The Chicago Board of Trade said only its financial and insurance futures and futures-options will be shut January 20. All other CBOT contracts will observe normal trading hours. Project A afternoon trading will be closed Monday, but evening pit trading and overnight Project A will be open.
At the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, only interest-rate and currency products will be closed all day January 20, while agricultural contracts will shut early at 1200 CST/1800 GMT.
CME's equity index and Goldman Sachs Commodity Index (GSCI) contracts will observe normal trading hours January 20.

CME's GLOBEX trading in equity index contracts will close January 20 at 0815 CST/1415 GMT, and GLOBEX interest-rate, currency and Taiwan contracts will shut at 1030 CST/1630 GMT. GLOBEX trading will reopen at 1430 CST/2030 GMT.
The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said interest-rate options trading will be shut January 20 but equity options and index options will observe normal trading hours.
On Friday, January 17, CBOE's interest-rate options will shut at 1200 CST/1800 GMT, but equity options and index options will close at their regular times.
At the CBOT, financial and insurance products will close early at 1210 CST/1810 GMT January 17. All other CBOT contracts will close at their usual times.
The CME said all contracts will shut early at 1200 CST/1800 GMT January 17 except GSCI and equity index products, which will close at their usual times.
GLOBEX Taiwan contracts January 17 will trade from 1830 CST/0030 GMT until 2115 CST/0315 GMT.
On Sunday, January 19, CBOT evening pit trading and overnight Project A trading will be shut.
CME's GLOBEX trading January 19 will start at 1730 CST/2330 GMT.
